beats: My kid finished her early task with twenty-five minutes of TV time still banked.
The reward reset her counter to a flat sixty minutes anyway, wiping out the time she hadn't used yet.
That's like finishing your chores early and having your allowance zeroed out instead of topped up.
I fixed the Cloudflare Worker behind the gate so early tasks add time instead of resetting it.
Twenty-five banked minutes plus a finished task now equals eighty-five minutes, not sixty.
